description: Use when an assignment must expire on a date, not stand forever. Trigger keywords: permission set expiration date, permission set group expiry, temporary access, time-boxed elevation, contractor access, ExpirationDate. NOT for PSG composition - use admin/permission-set-group-composition. NOT for muting mechanics - use security/permission-set-groups-and-muting. NOT for criteria-based auto-assignment - use admin/user-access-policies.
inputs: Which permission set or permission set group is being time-boxed, and whether one user or a batch is being assigned
The business end date for the access, and the time zone that end date is measured in
Whether psaExpirationUIEnabled is on in the target org — the Setup assignment screen offers an expiration control only when it is
Whether the same permissions are also granted by the assignee's profile or by a second, non-expiring permission set
Whether user access policies are enabled — that adds IsRevoked and the UserAccessChange trail to every assignment row
name: permission-set-expiration
official_sources: **Winter '27 (264) re-check, 2026-10-20** — `PermissionSetAssignment` description, calls and access (object_reference 264 L219697-L219708); field properties `ExpirationDate` (L219739-L219745), `IsActive` (L219747-L219753), `IsRevoked` (L219755-L219762), revoked-row usage and `ALL ROWS` query (L219894-L219901); `PermissionSetLicenseAssign` calls (L220298); `GroupMember` calls (L155436); `MutingPermissionSet` (L187698); session-based sets in a group (L264383); `UserManagementSettings.psaExpirationUIEnabled` (api_meta 264 L132107-L132111) and `userAccessPoliciesEnabled` (L132120-L132126); `UserAccessPolicy` version and permission (L141568, L141572); `UserAccessPolicyAction` fields (L141669-L141707). The Security Guide is not published at 264: every claim resting on it cites its Summer '26 line as `262: salesforce_security_impl_guide L<n>` (L809, L2042, L2055, L2064, L2069, L4974-L4975, L5034), per the writer brief's ground-truth rule.

**Object Reference for the Salesforce Platform, v67.0 (Summer '26)** — <https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.object_reference.meta/object_reference/sforce_api_objects_permissionsetassignment.htm> — fetched as the release PDF at <https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/object_reference.pdf>, pages 4249–4253. Source for: `PermissionSetAssignment` available in API version 22.0 and later; supported calls; Special Access Rules (View Setup and Configuration, Assign Permission Sets, Manage User); `ExpirationDate` as `dateTime` with Create/Filter/Nillable/Sort/Update in API version 52.0 and later; `IsActive` as read-only in API version 52.0 and later; `IsRevoked`, `LastCreatedByChangeId`, `LastDeletedByChangeId` in API version 57.0 and later when user access policies are enabled; the Create-only property of `AssigneeId`, `PermissionSetId`, and `PermissionSetGroupId`; the delete-and-insert update rule; the licence-match rule; and the `IsRevoked = true ALL ROWS` retrieval pattern.

**Object Reference for the Salesforce Platform, v67.0** — same PDF, pages 4254–4256, 4261–4263, 3619, 4244, 5118, 5828–5831. Source for: `PermissionSetGroup` `Status` values (`Updated`, `Outdated`, `Updating`, `Failed`) and `HasActivationRequired` in API version 53.0 and later; `PermissionSetLicenseAssign` having no `ExpirationDate` and no `update()` call; `MutingPermissionSet` being used in conjunction with `PermissionSetGroup`; `PermissionSet.Permissions<PermissionName>` and `IsOwnedByProfile` and the `LicenseId`-supersedes-`UserLicenseId` note; the `SessionPermSetActivation` note that group membership removes the activation requirement; `GroupMember`'s two fields; `UserAccessChange.Source`; and `UserAccessPolicy` requiring the Manage User Access Policies permission, with `Order` bounded 0–10,000 in API version 61.0 and later.

**Metadata API Developer Guide, v67.0 (Summer '26)** — <https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_meta.meta/api_meta/meta_usermanagementsettings.htm> — fetched as the release PDF at <https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf>, pages 2337–2341 and 2492–2497. Source for: `UserManagementSettings.psaExpirationUIEnabled` and its documented default of `false` in API version 52.0 and later; `userAccessPoliciesEnabled` in API version 58.0 and later; the User Management Settings Setup page; the `UserManagement.settings` file and the `Settings` manifest name; and the `UserAccessPolicyAction` field list (`action`, `target`, `type`) that confirms policies carry no expiration attribute.

**Salesforce Security Guide, v67.0 (Summer '26), last updated 24 April 2026** — <https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.securityImplGuide.meta/securityImplGuide/perm_sets_manage_assignments.htm> — fetched as the release PDF at <https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/salesforce_security_impl_guide.pdf>, pages 16, 38–39, 94–95. Source for: "To revoke a permission, you must remove all instances of the permission from the user"; the two assignment procedures and which one carries the expiration step; the user permissions required to assign and to remove; the note excluding guest, Self-Service, integration, and system users from the Manage Assignments page; the 1,000-user removal cap; the Setup Audit Trail tracked-change list including "Permission set (or group) changes to the assignment expiration date (beta)"; and the 180-day setup-history retention.

**Salesforce Help — Set Assignment Expiration Details for Users in Permission Sets and Permission Set Groups** — <https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.permissions_assign_expire_how.htm&type=5> — named by the Security Guide as the authority for expiration detail. **Not fetched and not cited for any claim in this skill**; `help.salesforce.com` returns an Aura shell to every fetcher. Listed here so a future reviewer knows where the unverifiable claims (exact expiry clock time, time-zone options, preset time frames) would be confirmed. Its sibling article, **Permission Assignment Expiration Considerations** (`sf.permissions_assign_expire_considerations.htm`), is the other unfetched page a reviewer with a browser should open before any of those details are asserted.

**Salesforce Well-Architected — Trusted / Secure** — <https://architect.salesforce.com/well-architected/trusted/secure> — the framing for least privilege and bounded access that this skill implements at the assignment level.

Related local coverage: `skills/admin/permission-set-group-composition` (what belongs inside a group), `skills/security/permission-set-groups-and-muting` (muting mechanics), `skills/admin/user-access-policies` (criteria-driven assignment), `skills/security/privileged-access-management` (the surrounding elevation control — see the contradiction log above).
outputs: A time-boxed assignment plan naming the permission set or group, the assignee, the ExpirationDate, and the approver
SOQL audit queries for assignments expiring soon, assignments already inactive, and assignments revoked by policy
A deployable UserManagementSettings snippet that turns on the expiration UI
A renewal procedure that updates ExpirationDate in place instead of deleting and re-inserting the assignment
A Setup Audit Trail evidence plan for the grant, the extension, and the expiry
